operation.provenBehavior: The handler resolves argument zero as an actor. Selector zero returns a signed controller byte, normalizing native state 8 to -1. Selector one checks both authored actor task records, retains the latter available task result, and normalizes values below one to -1. Argument two is not read.

evidenceBoundary: The handler and selector-one helper bytes are SHA-256 verified.
The browser runtime must obtain the actor/controller result from an authoritative actor adapter.
Missing actors or controller state remain explicit stops; no default status is inferred.
